messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — OrbitOne POC struggling on onboarding: transient 403s during auth then big bursts of 429s. They use an API gateway + serverless cold workers.
jordan_eng: Any SDK version info?
maya_cs: python-sdk v1.1.8 per their note. They also said the gateway injects a large tracking cookie.
samira_sre: Likely header size overflow. If Cookie + Authorization exceed gateway limit it can rewrite/drop auth -> 403. Clients retry and we see stampede -> 429.
leo_support: Customer snippet: 'gateway added tracking=eyJhbGciOi... ~380 bytes' plus our Bearer token.
jordan_eng: Quick mitigations: 1) Ask gateway team to strip analytics cookie on /v1/auth route. 2) Move non-auth metadata into POST body to internal analytics endpoint. 3) Short-term client patch: add exponential backoff + jitter on first auth retries.
maya_cs: Can you share a tiny backoff snippet we can paste into their docs?
jordan_eng: Sure — pseudo:
```
# python quick patch
import time, random

def auth_with_backoff(fn, attempts=5):
  for i in range(attempts):
    try:
      return fn()
    except Exception:
      time.sleep((2**i * 0.12) + random.random()*0.15)
  raise
```

samira_sre: Also recommend enabling keepalive on their worker pool to reduce cold TLS fanout. We'll add a doc note about 'gateway cookie interactions' to onboarding.
maya_cs: They've applied route-level cookie strip and will deploy the client patch. I'll monitor for 24h and update renewal health.
leo_support: Quick update — route strip removed 403s; after client backoff bursts dropped and no 429s in last 45min. Thanks team.
